source_need: Census population estimate for the fiscal-year/calendar-year basis used
public_use_rule: Use only for broad civic cost; do not imply every resident paid the same tax. U.S. resident population is sourced for CY2025.

source_need: IRS SOI return counts or a tax-unit source with year and taxable/non-taxable distinction
public_use_rule: Name whether the denominator is all returns, taxable returns, adults, households, or tax units.

source_need: SSA/CMS/payroll-tax covered worker source for the benefit program and year
public_use_rule: Use only for contributory payroll lanes; do not use for general-revenue public goods. OASDI covered workers are sourced for CY2025; Medicare HI covered workers still need a program-specific extraction.

source_need: Program beneficiary counts by program and year
public_use_rule: Use only for direct benefit programs and state the beneficiary definition. Social Security and Medicare total beneficiary context are sourced for CY2025; other programs still need extraction.

source_need: CMS or agency enrollee counts by Medicare part/program and year
public_use_rule: Use for health coverage programs; split Medicare HI from SMI before display. Medicare Part A/B/D enrollment is sourced for CY2025; non-Medicare health enrollment still needs extraction.

source_need: Census household count with year and geography
public_use_rule: Use only when household incidence is the intended display, not as a proxy for taxpayers. U.S. households are sourced for CY2025 CPS ASEC.
